messages:
katie: bringing up orca-mini-7b-q4 in the eval harness. hitting two issues: tokenizer seems to be duplicating a leading BOS in chat templates, and when I enable quantization the runner sometimes times out on long batches (>512 tokens). anyone seen this?

jorge: hmm, haven't tried orca-mini specifically. can you paste the model config you used?

katie: here you go:
```
model:
  name: orca-mini-7b-q4
  tokenizer: sentencepiece
  add_bos: true
chat_template:
  roles: [system, user]
  system_prompt: "{{system}}"
```
When I run the chat eval the system prompt appears twice in the decoded outputs (looks like both harness and runtime add BOS/system). also when I switch to q4 quantized runtime, the eval-runner process sometimes hangs and CI marks the job as timeout.

ana: fwiw we saw a similar double-BOS with some sentencepiece models — runtime will call `tokenizer.encode` and then the serving runtime also prepends a BOS for some families. try setting `add_bos: false` in the eval config or use `tokenizer_override: { add_bos: false }`. also check the chat template generator — it shouldn't add the system prompt if you already include it.

sam: the timeout is probably the runner bug I started on last week. quantized kernels sometimes return a partial KV response and the runner wait loop expects a full "end" signal; there's a race that causes the loop to hang. i've got a draft fix in runtime repo (PR 487) that adds a per-request watchdog and handles partials. i can push a PR for eval-runner to handle it too. for CI immediate workaround: mark q4 tests as flaky or bump timeout for quantized nightlies.

ml-eval-bot: CI alert: pipeline "eval-e2e" failed for commit 9b2c... test: e2e:orca-chat — failure reason: job timeout after 6m

jorge: also on the metric side — our current chat metrics are avg_bleu and manual fluency judgments, which are noisy for quantized models with subtle decoding artifacts. i'd prefer we add an embedding-similarity metric (cosine) as a fallback and a per-example flag for "truncated" or "prefixed_system_dup" so we can filter bad samples from aggregate scores.

katie: good call. dashboard expects metric key `avg_bleu` though so if we add `embed_cosine` we need a mapping in the reporting pipeline (alerts currently wired to avg_bleu < 0.2).

ana: i'll add a small onboarding checklist item: "tokenizer_override" and example toggles (add_bos true/false), plus a unit test for sentencepiece edge cases (emoji, leading spaces, multiple BOS). will also update docs in /docs/evals/tokenizers.md.

sam: i'll open the runtime PR today and bake in the watchdog. i'll also bump CI timeout to 10m for q4 jobs and annotate the nightlies as "quantized" to avoid spamming alerts. @katie can you paste a tiny reproducer with a few prompts?

katie: pasted quick repro below (3 prompts) — these are the exact lines I used in tests/chat_prompts.jsonl:
```
{"id":"t1","system":"You are a helpful assistant.","user":"Summarize the following text: ..."}
{"id":"t2","system":"You are a helpful assistant.","user":"Explain like I'm five: attention mechanism."}
{"id":"t3","system":"You are a helpful assistant.","user":"Translate to French: Hello world."}
```
When run: `python -m eval.runner --model orca-mini-7b-q4 --prompt-file tests/chat_prompts.jsonl --max-tokens 1024` you'll sometimes see duplicate system lines in outputs and occasional hangs on quantized runs.

jorge: sgtm. after fixes let's run: `python -m eval.runner --parallel-batches 2 --batch-size 8 --reporter prometheus` and check per-token latency + embed_cosine on the dashboard. i'll add an alert rule for embed_cosine drop and a label for `tokenizer_override` so we can slice regressions by tokenizer hints.

katie: thanks everyone — i'll try the `add_bos: false` override first and re-run CI. post results here. :thumbsup:
